text:
rita: Heads-up: launching storage-tier price experiment tomorrow morning. This one touches committed-storage discounts and the new "commit-to-save" promo. Need final signoff on grandfathering rules + invoice dispute handling for any prorated credits. Draft cohort list: https://drive.redwood/pricing/storage-cohorts-2026.csv

henry: Quick question: are we grandfathering based on subscription start or last invoice date? Some enterprise subs started long ago but were migrated recently.

sophia: We should use subscription creation date to avoid churn-based manipulation. Proposed rule: subs created before 2025-01-01 keep legacy per-GB rate for first billing cycle after rollout; commit-promos do not stack automatically. snippet:

```
grandfathering_rule:
  basis: "subscription_created"
  cutoff: "2025-01-01"
  preserve_cycles: 1
  promo_stackable: false
```

omar: For the commit-to-save promo, vendor passed through a small rebate (vendor-rebate-2026) but it's applied as an invoice-level credit by vendor. That means some customer invoices will show vendor credit separately which could confuse our billing reconciliation. Accounting flagged this.

accounting-bot: note: vendor rebate will be visible as external_credit field on incoming invoices starting 2026-03-01. Recommend tagging rows with `vendor_rebate_applied` during ETL.

henry: Can we add that tag and a reconciliation report for the last 3 cycles so accounting can verify the credit mapping?

omar: I'll add the ETL tag and a one-off reconciliation export. Plan: `vendor_rebate_applied=true` and include original_invoice_id mapping. PR target: 3 hours.

sophia: Approval workflow for manual grandfather exceptions? Last time we had 12 exceptions and no audit trail. I'm proposing a tiny approval form that writes to the ops ledger and notifies finance+sales. We need to capture reason and approver.

rita: Agreed. Let's use the existing "pricing-exceptions" Google form. It already writes to a sheet. Add a required field: approver-email. Also set up a Slack alert to #finance when a new row is added.

henry: For the experiment split, I'd like 15% canary vs 85% baseline to get slightly more signal for storage (low avg revenue per account). Rollback triggers: >2.5% MRR delta or >4% spike in billing disputes in a 2h window. Thoughts?

sophia: Sounds fine. Add a soft-alert threshold at 1% MRR delta to get early ops eyes.

billing-bot: sim: canary allocation 15% applied to cohorts. Simulated MRR delta (30m sample) = +0.6%. billing-dispute count = 0.

rita: Important: because of vendor rebate handling, we must ensure support templates explain why an invoice shows a vendor credit line. Omar, can you prepare a short KB and a canned response for support?

omar: Yep. I'll drop a KB draft in #support-docs and a canned reply in the support repo: `support/canned/rebate-explainer.md`.

henry: Also, make sure we don't double-apply promo stacking. If a customer is on a legacy rate and signs the commit promo, code must apply whichever gives lower effective price unless manual override flagged. That's a logic change. Engineering ok?

omar: That's an entitlement lookup change. I can carve a small PR: priority-high. Will include a feature flag `stack_promo_override=false` so we can flip if needed.

sophia: Timeline recap: Rita flips canary at 09:00 PT tomorrow. Henry monitors MRR signals and disputes. Omar handles ETL + support KB. Accounting will run reconciliation and confirm vendor rebates mapping within 24h. If any of the rollback triggers hit, we rollback to baseline and open follow-up.

rita: One more: disputes automation. If a customer raises a billing dispute referencing vendor credit visibility, support should tag `billing:v-rebate` and the thread auto-notifies accounting. Can we hook that into the inbound ticket processor?

accounting-bot: action: added webhook `ticket_processor -> /hooks/accounting/rebate_alert` and will post to #finance when tag observed.

henry: PR for ETL and reconciliation: https://git.redwood/data/etl/pulls/789. Omar's KB draft: https://docs.redwood/support/rebate-kb-draft.md

omar: All set on my side for the ETL flag PR and support draft. ETA 2.5h.

sophia: I'll set the soft-alert dashboard and an early-warning Slack bot to ping #finance at 1% MRR delta.

rita: Thanks. Final call: any objections to proceed with 15% canary at 09:00 PT? If none, I'll flip. :thumbsup:

henry: :thumbsup:

sophia: :thumbsup:

omar: :thumbsup:

accounting-bot: scheduled snapshot: ledger-snapshot-2026-03-02-08:55-PT for baseline comparisons.
